# appgatesdp_entitlement (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appgatesdp_site" "default" {
  name = "Default Site"
}

resource "appgatesdp_entitlement" "git" {
  name       = "git"
  site       = data.appgatesdp_site.default.id
  conditions = []

  actions = [{
    subtype = "tcp_up"
    action  = "allow"
    hosts   = ["git.internal.example.com"]
    ports   = ["443", "22"]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) List of all IP Access actions in this Entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `conditions` (List of String) List of Condition IDs applied to this Entitlement.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `site` (String) ID of the Site for this Entitlement.

### Optional

- `app_shortcut_scripts` (List of String) List of Entitlement Script IDs used for creating App Shortcuts dynamically.
- `app_shortcuts` (Attributes List) Array of App Shortcuts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--app_shortcuts))
- `condition_logic` (String) Whether all the Conditions must succeed to have access to this Entitlement or just one.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If true, the Entitlement will be disregarded during authorization.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `risk_sensitivity` (String) Generate Conditions for the Entitlement based on the Risk Model. Cannot be combined with other Conditions. Deprecated as of 6.5. Please use Conditions instead. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `optimization_score` (String) Indicates how optimized this Entitlement is based on usage data. Actions or hosts/ports/types/methods marked as optimizationExempt are excluded from this calculation. Licensed feature. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `optimization_score_percentage` (Number) Numeric percentage score representing how optimized this Entitlement is based on usage data. Licensed feature. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `site_name` (String) Name of the Site for this Entitlement. For convenience only.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `action` (String) Applied action to the traffic.
- `hosts` (List of String) Hosts to apply the action to. See admin manual for possible values.

Optional:

- `methods` (List of String) HTTP method. Only valid for http subtypes. Leave it empty to allow all types.
- `monitor` (Attributes) Only available for tcp_up and http_up subtypes. If enabled, Gateways will monitor this action for responsiveness and act accordingly. See admin manual for more details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions--monitor))
- `optimization_exempt_hosts` (List of String) Hosts exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. Traffic to these hosts will not be considered when calculating the optimization score for this action. Uses the same format as hosts. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `optimization_exempt_methods` (List of String) HTTP methods exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. Traffic using these methods will not be considered when calculating the optimization score for this action. Only valid for http subtypes. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `optimization_exempt_ports` (List of String) Destination ports exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. Traffic on these ports will not be considered when calculating the optimization score for this action. Only valid for tcp, udp, ssh, and rdp subtypes. Uses the same format as ports. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `optimization_exempt_types` (List of String) ICMP types exempt from Entitlement Optimization analysis. Traffic of these types will not be considered when calculating the optimization score for this action. Only valid for icmp subtypes. Uses the same format as types. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `ports` (List of String) Destination port. Multiple ports can be entered comma separated. Port ranges can be entered dash separated. Only valid for tcp, udp, ssh, and rdp subtypes
- `subtype` (String) Type of the IP Access action. Required unless the action is exclude.
- `types` (List of String) ICMP type. Only valid for icmp subtypes.

<a id="nestedatt--actions--monitor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions.monitor`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `timeout` (Number) Number of seconds the action needs to be unresponsive to mark the action unhealthy.
